decisions.choice: heard before the governor: reaches the governor's ears
alternatives: is heard as a case in the governor's court
decisions.reason: The words can mean that the report comes to the governor, or that the matter comes before him for judgment. Either way the priests promise to protect the soldiers.

decisions.choice: the governor: Pilate
decisions.reason: Pilate was the Roman governor of Judea (27:2). Soldiers who slept on guard and lost their charge could be severely punished.

decisions.choice: persuade: talk him round, perhaps with money
decisions.reason: The verb means to persuade or win over. Matthew does not say how; the priests have just used money with the soldiers.

decisions.choice: him for the governor, with no span
decisions.reason: The pronoun refers to Pilate.

en.L: And they took the silver coins and did as they had been instructed.

ja.L: 彼らは銀貨を受け取って、教えられたとおりにした。

ja.R: 兵士たちはお金を受け取って、言われたとおりに話しました。

decisions.choice: were instructed: were taught what to say
decisions.reason: The verb is the usual word for teaching. The soldiers are taught a false story; at the end of the chapter Jesus sends his disciples to teach what he commanded (28:20).

decisions.choice: the soldiers
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable name the subject.

decisions.choice: said what they had been told to say
decisions.reason: Readable says what they did: they told the story they were given.

decisions.choice: "教えられた" (L, B)
decisions.reason: The verb is the usual word for teaching (meaning decision m1), and "教える" returns in 28:20, where Jesus sends his disciples to teach; Readable says what the soldiers did.

source.text: Καὶ διεφημίσθη ὁ λόγος οὗτος παρὰ Ἰουδαίοις μέχρι τῆς σήμερον ἡμέρας.

records.literal_gloss: And was spread abroad the word this among Jews until the today day.

en.L: And this account was spread about among Jews until the present day.
en.B: And this is the account that has gone around among Jews up to the present day.
en.R: Even now, this story is still being told among Jewish people.

es.L: Y este relato se divulgó entre judíos hasta el día de hoy.
es.B: Y esta es la versión que ha circulado entre judíos hasta el día de hoy.
es.R: Incluso ahora, todavía se cuenta esta historia entre gente judía.

fr.L: Et ce récit a été répandu parmi des Juifs jusqu’à ce jour.
fr.B: Et c’est ce récit qui circule dans des milieux juifs jusqu’à aujourd’hui.
fr.R: Aujourd’hui encore, cette histoire se raconte chez des Juifs.

sw.L: Na habari hii ilienezwa miongoni mwa Wayahudi mpaka siku ya leo.
sw.B: Na hii ndiyo habari ambayo imeenea miongoni mwa Wayahudi mpaka leo.
sw.R: Hata sasa habari hii bado inasimuliwa miongoni mwa Wayahudi.

vi.L: Và chuyện này được đồn ra trong người Do Thái cho đến ngày nay.
vi.B: Câu chuyện ấy đã được loan truyền trong giới người Do Thái cho đến ngày nay.
vi.R: Cho đến ngày nay, một số người Do Thái vẫn còn kể câu chuyện này.

ko.L: 그리고 이 말이 오늘날까지 유대인들 사이에 퍼져 있다.
ko.B: 그래서 이 이야기가 오늘날까지 유대인들 사이에 널리 퍼져 있다.
ko.R: 지금도 유대 사람들 가운데는 이 이야기를 하는 사람들이 있다.

pt.L: E esta história foi divulgada entre judeus até o dia de hoje.
pt.B: E é essa a história que circula entre judeus até o dia de hoje.
pt.R: Até hoje essa história ainda é contada entre o povo judeu.

am.L: ይህም ቃል እስከ ዛሬ ቀን ድረስ በአይሁድ ዘንድ ተሰራጭቷል።
am.B: እስከ ዛሬ ድረስ በአይሁድ መካከል የሚወራው ወሬ ይህ ነው።
am.R: ይህ ወሬ እስከ ዛሬ ድረስ በአይሁድ ሰዎች መካከል ይነገራል።

ru.L: И распространилось это слово среди иудеев до сегодняшнего дня.
ru.B: Этот рассказ ходит среди иудеев и сегодня.
ru.R: Эту историю рассказывают среди иудеев до сих пор.

hi.L: और यह बात आज के दिन तक यहूदियों में फैली हुई है।
hi.B: और यही बात आज तक यहूदियों में फैली हुई है।
hi.R: आज भी यहूदी लोगों के बीच यही कहानी सुनाई जाती है।

uk.L: І рознеслося це слово серед юдеїв аж до сьогоднішнього дня.
uk.B: І ця розповідь ходить серед юдеїв аж до сьогоднішнього дня.
uk.R: І досі цю історію розповідають серед юдеїв.

ja.L: そしてこの話は、今日までユダヤ人の間に広まっている。
ja.B: こうしてこの話は、今日に至るまでユダヤ人の間に広まっている。
ja.R: この話は、今でもユダヤ人の間で語られています。

decisions.choice: until the present day: up to the time Matthew wrote
decisions.reason: "To this day" is the writer's time, as in 27:8. Matthew tells his first readers where a story they may have heard came from.

decisions.choice: among Jews: in Jewish circles, not all Jewish people
alternatives: among the Jewish people as a whole
decisions.reason: The noun has no article. Matthew, a Jewish writer, does not say that all Jews believed the story, only that it was told among Jews. The chief priests' story is the issue here, not the Jewish people.

decisions.choice: even now
decisions.reason: Readable keeps the writer's "now"; the meaning note says whose time it is.

decisions.choice: entre judíos; entre gente judía (R), without the article
decisions.reason: "Entre los judíos" would say that all Jewish people told the story; without the article the phrase means in Jewish circles, as the Greek does (meaning decision m2).

decisions.choice: parmi des Juifs (L); dans des milieux juifs (B); chez des Juifs (R)
decisions.reason: The Greek has no article: the story went round in Jewish circles, not among all Jewish people (m2). French "les Juifs" would say all of them, so every level keeps the indefinite "des". The passé composé at Literal and the present at Balanced and Readable say that the story still goes round in the writer's day.

decisions.choice: "trong người Do Thái" (L); "trong giới người Do Thái" (B); "một số người Do Thái" (R)
decisions.reason: The meaning decision says Jewish circles are meant, not all Jewish people; Balanced and Readable make that plain.

decisions.choice: "유대인들 사이에" (L, B); "유대 사람들 가운데는 ... 사람들이 있다" (R)
decisions.reason: Among Jews means in Jewish circles, not all Jewish people (meaning decision); Readable says so plainly.

decisions.choice: entre o povo judeu
decisions.reason: As the English "among Jewish people": Readable avoids "os judeus", which would read as all Jews, against m2. Literal and Balanced keep "entre judeus" without the article, as the Greek has it.

source.text: Οἱ δὲ ἕνδεκα μαθηταὶ ἐπορεύθησαν εἰς τὴν Γαλιλαίαν εἰς τὸ ὄρος οὗ ἐτάξατο αὐτοῖς ὁ Ἰησοῦς, καὶ ἰδόντες αὐτὸν προσεκύνησαν, οἱ δὲ ἐδίστασαν.

records.literal_gloss: The and eleven disciples went into Galilee to the mountain where had appointed them Jesus, \v 17 and having seen him they worshiped, some but doubted.

en.L: And the eleven disciples went into Galilee, to the mountain where Jesus had directed them, \v 17 and seeing {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, they worshiped, but some doubted.
en.B: The eleven disciples made their way to Galilee, to the mountain Jesus had appointed for them. \v 17 When they saw {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} there, they bowed in worship, but some had doubts.
en.R: Then the eleven followers went to Galilee. They went to the mountain where Jesus had told them to go. \v 17 When they saw Jesus, they worshiped {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}. But some of them were not sure what to think.

es.L: Y los once discípulos fueron a Galilea, al monte donde Jesús les había ordenado, \v 17 y, al verlo, adoraron; pero algunos dudaron.
es.B: Los once discípulos se dirigieron a Galilea, al monte que Jesús les había indicado. \v 17 Cuando {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} vieron allí, se postraron en adoración, aunque algunos tenían dudas.
es.R: Después los once seguidores fueron a Galilea. Fueron al monte adonde Jesús les había dicho que fueran. \v 17 Cuando vieron a Jesús, {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} adoraron. Pero algunos de ellos no estaban seguros de qué pensar.

fr.L: Or les onze disciples allèrent en Galilée, à la montagne que Jésus leur avait désignée, \v 17 et, {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}ayant vu, ils adorèrent ; mais certains doutèrent.
fr.B: Les onze disciples se rendirent en Galilée, sur la montagne que Jésus leur avait indiquée. \v 17 Quand ils {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} virent, ils se prosternèrent pour {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}adorer ; mais quelques-uns hésitaient.
fr.R: Ensuite, les onze disciples sont allés en Galilée. Ils sont allés sur la montagne où Jésus leur avait dit d’aller. \v 17 Quand ils ont vu Jésus, ils {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}ont adoré. Mais certains d’entre eux ne savaient pas quoi penser.

sw.L: Basi wanafunzi wale kumi na mmoja walisafiri kwenda Galilaya, hadi mlimani pale Yesu alipokuwa amewapangia, \v 17 na walipomwona, waliabudu, ila baadhi yao walisita.
sw.B: Wanafunzi kumi na mmoja walikwenda Galilaya, kwenye mlima ambao Yesu alikuwa amewaonyesha. \v 17 Walipomwona huko, waliinama kumwabudu, lakini baadhi yao walikuwa na mashaka.
sw.R: Kisha wale wafuasi kumi na mmoja walikwenda Galilaya. Walikwenda kwenye mlima ule ambao Yesu aliwaambia waende. \v 17 Walipomwona Yesu, walimwabudu. Lakini baadhi yao hawakuwa na uhakika wafikiri nini.

vi.L: Còn mười một môn đồ thì đi đến Ga-li-lê, lên ngọn núi mà Đức Giê-xu đã chỉ định cho họ, \v 17 và khi thấy {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, họ thờ lạy, nhưng có mấy người nghi ngờ.
vi.B: Mười một môn đồ đi đến Ga-li-lê, lên ngọn núi mà Đức Giê-xu đã hẹn với họ. \v 17 Khi thấy {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} ở đó, họ thờ lạy {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, nhưng có mấy người còn ngần ngại.
vi.R: Rồi mười một môn đồ đi đến Ga-li-lê. Họ lên ngọn núi mà Đức Giê-xu đã bảo họ đến. \v 17 Khi thấy Đức Giê-xu, họ thờ lạy {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. Nhưng có mấy người chưa biết phải nghĩ thế nào.

ko.L: 그런데 열한 제자는 갈릴리로 가서, 예수께서 그들에게 정해 주신 산으로 갔다. \v 17 그리고 그분을 보고 경배하였다. 그러나 어떤 이들은 의심하였다.
ko.B: 열한 제자는 갈릴리로 가서, 예수께서 그들에게 일러 주신 산으로 갔다. \v 17 그리고 거기서 예수를 뵙고 엎드려 경배했다. 그러나 몇몇은 의심했다.
ko.R: 그 뒤에 열한 제자는 갈릴리로 갔다. 그들은 예수께서 가라고 말씀하신 산으로 갔다. \v 17 제자들은 예수를 뵙고 엎드려 경배했다. 그러나 그들 가운데 몇몇은 어떻게 생각해야 할지 몰라 망설였다.

pt.L: E os onze discípulos foram para a Galileia, ao monte que Jesus lhes tinha designado, \v 17 e, vendo-{{deity_pronoun:o|O}}, [{{deity_pronoun:o|O}}] adoraram; mas alguns duvidaram.
pt.B: Os onze discípulos foram para a Galileia, ao monte que Jesus lhes tinha indicado. \v 17 Quando {{deity_pronoun:o|O}} viram ali, prostraram-se em adoração, mas alguns ficaram em dúvida.
pt.R: Então os onze seguidores foram para a Galileia. Foram até o monte aonde Jesus tinha mandado que eles fossem. \v 17 Quando viram Jesus, eles {{deity_pronoun:o|O}} adoraram. Mas alguns deles não sabiam bem o que pensar.

am.L: አሥራ አንዱ ደቀ መዛሙርትም ወደ ገሊላ፣ ኢየሱስ ወዳዘዛቸው ተራራ ሄዱ፤ \v 17 ባዩትም ጊዜ ሰገዱ፤ አንዳንዶቹ ግን ተጠራጠሩ።
am.B: አሥራ አንዱ ደቀ መዛሙርት ወደ ገሊላ፣ ኢየሱስ ወደ ቀጠራቸው ተራራ ሄዱ። \v 17 በዚያም ባዩት ጊዜ ሰገዱለት፤ አንዳንዶቹ ግን ተጠራጠሩ።
am.R: ከዚያም አሥራ አንዱ ደቀ መዛሙርት ወደ ገሊላ ሄዱ። ኢየሱስ እንዲሄዱ ወደ ነገራቸው ተራራ ሄዱ። \v 17 ኢየሱስን ባዩት ጊዜ ሰገዱለት። ከእነርሱ አንዳንዶቹ ግን ምን እንደሚያስቡ እርግጠኞች አልነበሩም።

ru.L: Одиннадцать же учеников пошли в Галилею, на гору, куда указал им Иисус, \v 17 и, увидев {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}}, поклонились, некоторые же усомнились.
ru.B: Одиннадцать учеников отправились в Галилею, на гору, которую назначил им Иисус. \v 17 Увидев {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} там, они поклонились, но некоторые колебались.
ru.R: Потом одиннадцать учеников пошли в Галилею. Они пришли на гору, куда велел им прийти Иисус. \v 17 Когда они увидели Иисуса, они поклонились {{deity_pronoun:ему|Ему}}. Но некоторые из них не знали, что и думать.

hi.L: और ग्यारह चेले गलील में उस पहाड़ पर गए, जहाँ यीशु ने उन्हें ठहराया था, \v 17 और उन्हें देखकर उन्होंने दंडवत किया, पर कुछ ने संदेह किया।
hi.B: ग्यारह चेले गलील में उस पहाड़ पर गए जो यीशु ने उनके लिए ठहराया था। \v 17 वहाँ उन्हें देखकर उन्होंने झुककर उनकी आराधना की, पर कुछ के मन में संदेह था।
hi.R: तब ग्यारह चेले गलील गए। वे उस पहाड़ पर गए जहाँ यीशु ने उन्हें जाने को कहा था। \v 17 जब उन्होंने यीशु को देखा, तो उन्होंने उनकी आराधना की। पर उनमें से कुछ को समझ नहीं आ रहा था कि क्या सोचें।

uk.L: А одинадцять учнів пішли в Галилею, на гору, куди звелів їм Ісус, \v 17 і, побачивши {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}}, поклонилися, а деякі засумнівалися.
uk.B: Одинадцять учнів вирушили в Галилею, на гору, яку визначив їм Ісус. \v 17 Коли вони побачили там {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}}, то вклонилися {{deity_pronoun:йому|Йому}}, але деякі мали сумніви.
uk.R: Тоді одинадцять учнів пішли в Галилею. Вони пішли на гору, куди Ісус звелів їм прийти. \v 17 Коли вони побачили Ісуса, то вклонилися {{deity_pronoun:йому|Йому}}. Але деякі з них не знали, що й думати.

ja.L: さて十一人の弟子たちは、ガリラヤに、イエスが彼らに指示しておかれた山に行った。\v 17 そしてイエスを見て、拝んだ。しかし、ある者たちは疑った。
ja.B: 十一人の弟子たちはガリラヤへ行き、イエスが指示しておられた山に登った。\v 17 そしてイエスに会うと、ひれ伏して拝んだ。しかし、疑う者たちもいた。
ja.R: それから、十一人の弟子たちはガリラヤへ行きました。イエスが行くように言われた山に行ったのです。\v 17 弟子たちはイエスを見て、拝みました。でも、何人かは、どう考えたらよいかわかりませんでした。

decisions.choice: the eleven: the Twelve without Judas
decisions.reason: Judas had betrayed Jesus and hanged himself (27:3-5).

decisions.choice: the mountain Jesus had appointed: a place he had named to them
decisions.reason: The verb means to arrange or appoint. Matthew has not told us when Jesus named the place, and he does not name the mountain. In Matthew mountains are places where Jesus teaches and is revealed (5:1; 17:1).

decisions.choice: some doubted: some of the eleven hesitated
alternatives: they all worshiped, though they doubted
decisions.reason: The words can mean that some of the eleven doubted, that all of them worshiped and yet wavered, or that others there doubted. The verb means to waver or hesitate, as of Peter on the water (14:31); it is not refusal to believe. Matthew does not explain it, and Jesus comes to them all (28:18).

decisions.choice: worshiped: bowed down before him
decisions.reason: As in 28:9, the women's response is now the disciples' (compare 14:33).

decisions.choice: had doubts
decisions.reason: Balanced uses a phrase that leaves room for wavering rather than unbelief.

decisions.choice: some of them were not sure what to think
decisions.reason: Readable takes "some" as some of the eleven, the reading the meaning note gives first, and says what wavering is.

decisions.choice: hésitaient (B)
decisions.reason: As the English "had doubts", Balanced uses a verb that means wavering rather than unbelief; the imperfect says that it went on as they stood there. Literal keeps "doutèrent".

decisions.choice: walisita (L); walikuwa na mashaka (B)
decisions.reason: The verb means to hesitate, to be in two minds (meaning decision m3); Literal says "walisita" (they hesitated), Balanced the fuller "had doubts", as the English Balanced does.

decisions.choice: "nghi ngờ" (L); "ngần ngại" (B); "chưa biết phải nghĩ thế nào" (R)
decisions.reason: The footnoted meaning decision reads the verb as hesitation among the eleven; Balanced and Readable say that rather than outright unbelief.

decisions.choice: "열한 제자" at every level; "의심하다" (L, B), "망설이다" (R) for distazo
decisions.reason: The Twelve without Judas (meaning decision); some of the eleven hesitated (meaning decision, footnoted), which Readable says with "망설이다".

decisions.choice: ficaram em dúvida
decisions.reason: As the English "had doubts": "ficar em dúvida" is wavering, not refusal to believe (m3).

decisions.choice: "疑った" (L), "疑う者たちもいた" (B); "どう考えたらよいかわからなかった" (R)
decisions.reason: The verb is the one of 14:31, which Japanese gives as "疑う"; it means to waver, not to refuse belief (meaning decision m3), and "疑う" leaves open who the some were. Readable says what wavering is, as the English does.

source.text: καὶ προσελθὼν ὁ Ἰησοῦς ἐλάλησεν αὐτοῖς λέγων· Ἐδόθη μοι πᾶσα ἐξουσία ἐν οὐρανῷ καὶ ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς·

records.literal_gloss: And having come to [them] Jesus spoke to them saying, Was given to me all authority in heaven and on the earth;

en.L: And coming to [them], Jesus spoke to them, saying, "All authority in heaven and on earth was given to {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}.
en.B: Jesus came up to them and said, "All authority in heaven and on earth has been placed in {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} hands.
en.R: Jesus came to them and said, "God has given {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} all authority in heaven and on earth.

es.L: Y, acercándose, Jesús les habló, diciendo: «Toda autoridad en el cielo y sobre la tierra {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} fue dada.
es.B: Jesús se acercó a ellos y les dijo: «Toda autoridad en el cielo y en la tierra ha sido puesta en {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} manos.
es.R: Jesús se acercó a ellos y les dijo: «Dios {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} ha dado toda autoridad en el cielo y en la tierra.

fr.L: Et Jésus, s’étant approché, leur parla, disant : « Toute autorité {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}a été donnée au ciel et sur la terre.
fr.B: Jésus s’approcha d’eux et leur dit : « Toute autorité au ciel et sur la terre a été remise entre {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} mains.
fr.R: Jésus est venu vers eux et leur a dit : « Dieu {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}a donné toute autorité au ciel et sur la terre.

sw.L: Na Yesu, akiwa amewakaribia, aliongea nao, akisema, "Mamlaka yote mbinguni na juu ya dunia yalitolewa {{deity_pronoun:kwangu|Kwangu}}.
sw.B: Yesu aliwakaribia, akasema, "Mamlaka yote mbinguni na duniani yamewekwa mikononi {{deity_pronoun:mwangu|Mwangu}}.
sw.R: Yesu aliwakaribia, akasema, "Mungu amenipa mamlaka yote mbinguni na duniani.

vi.L: Và Đức Giê-xu đến gần và nói với họ: "Mọi thẩm quyền trên trời và dưới đất đã được ban cho {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}.
vi.B: Đức Giê-xu đến gần và nói với họ: "Mọi thẩm quyền trên trời và dưới đất đã được giao vào tay {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}.
vi.R: Đức Giê-xu đến gần họ và nói: "Đức Chúa Trời đã ban cho {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} mọi thẩm quyền trên trời và dưới đất.

ko.L: 그리고 예수께서 [그들에게] 다가오셔서 그들에게 말씀하셨다. "하늘과 땅의 모든 권세가 나에게 주어졌다.
ko.B: 예수께서 그들에게 다가오셔서 말씀하셨다. "하늘과 땅의 모든 권세를 내가 받았다.
ko.R: 예수께서 제자들에게 오셔서 말씀하셨다. "하나님께서 하늘과 땅의 모든 권세를 나에게 주셨다.

pt.L: E Jesus, aproximando-se, falou-lhes, dizendo: "Foi dada a {{deity_pronoun:mim|Mim}} toda a autoridade no céu e na terra.
pt.B: Jesus se aproximou deles e disse: "Toda a autoridade no céu e na terra foi posta nas {{deity_pronoun:minhas|Minhas}} mãos.
pt.R: Jesus chegou perto deles e disse: "Deus {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} deu toda a autoridade no céu e na terra.

am.L: ኢየሱስም ቀርቦ እንዲህ ሲል ተናገራቸው፦ «በሰማይና በምድር ላይ ያለ ሥልጣን ሁሉ ለእኔ ተሰጠኝ።
am.B: ኢየሱስም ወደ እነርሱ ቀርቦ እንዲህ አላቸው፦ «በሰማይና በምድር ያለው ሥልጣን ሁሉ በእጄ ተሰጥቷል።
am.R: ኢየሱስም ወደ እነርሱ መጥቶ እንዲህ አላቸው፦ «እግዚአብሔር በሰማይና በምድር ያለውን ሥልጣን ሁሉ ሰጥቶኛል።

ru.L: И, подойдя, Иисус заговорил с ними, говоря: «Дана {{deity_pronoun:мне|Мне}} всякая власть на небе и на земле.
ru.B: Иисус подошёл к ним и сказал: «Мне дана вся власть на небе и на земле.
ru.R: Иисус подошёл к ним и сказал: «Бог дал {{deity_pronoun:мне|Мне}} всю власть на небе и на земле.

hi.L: और यीशु ने पास आकर उनसे यह कहते हुए बात की, "स्वर्ग में और पृथ्वी पर सारा अधिकार मुझे दिया गया है।
hi.B: यीशु ने उनके पास आकर कहा, "स्वर्ग और पृथ्वी का सारा अधिकार मेरे हाथ में सौंपा गया है।
hi.R: यीशु ने उनके पास आकर कहा, "परमेश्वर ने स्वर्ग में और पृथ्वी पर सारा अधिकार मुझे दे दिया है।

uk.L: І, підійшовши, Ісус заговорив до них, кажучи: «Дана {{deity_pronoun:мені|Мені}} всяка влада на небі і на землі.
uk.B: Ісус підійшов до них і сказав: «Мені дано всю владу на небі і на землі.
uk.R: Ісус підійшов до них і сказав: «Бог дав {{deity_pronoun:мені|Мені}} всю владу на небі і на землі.

ja.L: そしてイエスは近寄って来て、彼らに語って言われた。「天においても地においても、すべての権威がわたしに与えられた。
ja.B: イエスは近寄って来て言われた。「わたしは、天と地のすべての権威を授けられている。
ja.R: イエスは弟子たちのところに来て、言われました。「神は、天でも地でも、すべての権威をわたしに与えてくださった。

decisions.choice: all authority was given to me: Daniel 7:14
alternatives: a general statement with no echo
decisions.reason: In Daniel 7:13-14 one like a son of man comes before God and is given authority, and all the nations serve him. The Greek Old Testament uses the same words "authority was given". Jesus, the Son of Man, now claims that authority without limit.

decisions.choice: was given: given by God the Father
decisions.reason: The verb is passive, with God as the giver, as in 11:27: "All things have been handed over to me by my Father."

decisions.choice: all authority in heaven and on earth: rule over all things
decisions.reason: Jesus had authority on earth to forgive sins (9:6). Now it is all authority, in heaven as well. The devil offered him the kingdoms of the world for worship (4:8-9); the Father has given him more.

decisions.choice: the quotation opens here and closes at the end of 28:20
decisions.reason: Jesus's last words run across two sentences, so the quotation marks stay open to the end of the Gospel.

decisions.choice: has been placed in my hands
decisions.reason: Balanced uses a natural English picture of being entrusted with something.

decisions.choice: God has given
decisions.reason: Readable names God as the giver, as the passive implies.

decisions.choice: autoridad
decisions.reason: The term used for this word throughout the New Testament: the right and power to rule (meaning decision m3). "Poder" would suggest strength alone; "potestad" is old-fashioned.

decisions.choice: mamlaka
decisions.reason: The term used for this word throughout the New Testament: the right and power to rule (meaning decision m3). "Uwezo" would suggest ability alone, and "haki" is kept for righteousness.

decisions.choice: "thẩm quyền" for exousia
decisions.reason: "thẩm quyền" is the right to rule, which the meaning decision describes; "quyền năng" would be power to act, a different word in Greek.

decisions.choice: "권세" for exousia; "주어졌다" (L), "내가 받았다" (B), "하나님께서 ... 나에게 주셨다" (R)
decisions.reason: Rule over all things given by God the Father (meaning decision), in the words of Daniel 7:14; Readable names the giver, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: [그들에게] (L)
decisions.reason: Korean "다가오다" needs to say to whom; the English Literal brackets it too.

decisions.choice: "ሥልጣን" (authority)
decisions.reason: Exousia is the right and rule to act, not strength as such; "ሥልጣን" is the Amharic word for authority given to someone.

decisions.choice: "дана вся власть" (B)
alternatives: "вся власть вложена в мои руки", as the English
decisions.reason: The plain Russian passive is natural here, so Balanced needs no picture of hands.

decisions.choice: "権威" at every level; "与えられた" (L), "授けられている" (B), "神は……与えてくださった" (R)
decisions.reason: "権威" is the word of 9:6 in Japanese, so the step from authority on earth to all authority can be heard (meaning decision m3). The passive points to God as the giver (m2), whom Readable names, as the English does.

source.text: πορευθέντες οὖν μαθητεύσατε πάντα τὰ ἔθνη, βαπτίζοντες αὐτοὺς εἰς τὸ ὄνομα τοῦ πατρὸς καὶ τοῦ υἱοῦ καὶ τοῦ ἁγίου πνεύματος, διδάσκοντες αὐτοὺς τηρεῖν πάντα ὅσα ἐνετειλάμην ὑμῖν· καὶ ἰδοὺ ἐγὼ μεθ’ ὑμῶν εἰμι πάσας τὰς ἡμέρας ἕως τῆς συντελείας τοῦ αἰῶνος.

records.literal_gloss: Having gone therefore make disciples all the nations, baptizing them into the name of the Father and of the Son and of the Holy Spirit, \v 20 teaching them to keep all things as many as I commanded you; and behold I with you am all the days until the completion of the age.

en.L: Going, therefore, make disciples of all the nations, baptizing them into the name of the Father and of the Son and of the Holy Spirit, \v 20 teaching them to keep all things that I commanded you; and look, I am with you all the days until the completion of the age."
en.B: Go, then, and make disciples of all the nations: baptize them into the name of the Father and of the Son and of the Holy Spirit, \v 20 and teach them to keep everything I have commanded you. And remember this: I myself am with you every day, until the close of the age."
en.R: So go and make disciples of people from every nation. Baptize them in the name of the Father and of the Son and of the Holy Spirit. \v 20 Teach them to do all that I have told you to do. And remember, I am with you every day, until the end of this age."

es.L: Yendo, pues, {{plural_you:hagan|haced}} discípulos de todas las naciones, bautizándolos en el nombre del Padre y del Hijo y del Espíritu Santo, \v 20 enseñándoles a guardar todo cuanto {{plural_you:les|os}} he mandado; y {{plural_you:miren|mirad}}, yo estoy con {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} todos los días hasta la consumación de la era».
es.B: Así que {{plural_you:vayan|id}} y {{plural_you:hagan|haced}} discípulos de todas las naciones: {{plural_you:bautícenlos|bautizadlos}} en el nombre del Padre y del Hijo y del Espíritu Santo, \v 20 y {{plural_you:enséñenles|enseñadles}} a guardar todo lo que {{plural_you:les|os}} he mandado. Y {{plural_you:recuerden|recordad}} esto: yo mismo estoy con {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} todos los días, hasta el fin de la era».
es.R: Así que {{plural_you:vayan|id}} y {{plural_you:hagan|haced}} discípulos de gente de todas las naciones. {{plural_you:Bautícenlos|Bautizadlos}} en el nombre del Padre, del Hijo y del Espíritu Santo. \v 20 {{plural_you:Enséñenles|Enseñadles}} a hacer todo lo que {{plural_you:les|os}} he mandado. Y {{plural_you:recuerden|recordad}}: yo estoy con {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} todos los días, hasta el fin de esta era».

fr.L: Allant donc, faites des disciples de toutes les nations, les baptisant dans le nom du Père et du Fils et de l’Esprit Saint, \v 20 leur enseignant à garder tout ce que je vous ai commandé ; et voici, {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}, je suis avec vous tous les jours jusqu’à la fin de l’âge. »
fr.B: Allez donc, et faites des disciples dans toutes les nations : baptisez-les dans le nom du Père, et du Fils, et de l’Esprit Saint, \v 20 et apprenez-leur à garder tout ce que je vous ai commandé. Et souvenez-vous de ceci : {{deity_pronoun:moi-même|Moi-même}}, je suis avec vous chaque jour, jusqu’à la fin de l’âge présent. »
fr.R: Allez donc, et faites des disciples parmi les gens de toutes les nations. Baptisez-les au nom du Père, du Fils et de l’Esprit Saint. \v 20 Apprenez-leur à faire tout ce que je vous ai dit de faire. Et souvenez-vous : je suis avec vous chaque jour, jusqu’à la fin du monde. »

sw.L: Kwa hiyo mkienda, wafanyeni mataifa yote kuwa wanafunzi, mkiwabatiza katika jina la Baba na la Mwana na la Roho Mtakatifu, \v 20 mkiwafundisha kushika kila kitu nilichowaamuru; na tazama, {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} niko pamoja nanyi siku zote mpaka utimilifu wa enzi."
sw.B: Basi nendeni, mkawafanye watu wa mataifa yote kuwa wanafunzi: wabatizeni katika jina la Baba na la Mwana na la Roho Mtakatifu, \v 20 na kuwafundisha kushika kila kitu nilichowaamuru. Na kumbukeni hili: {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} {{deity_pronoun:mwenyewe|Mwenyewe}} niko pamoja nanyi kila siku, mpaka mwisho wa enzi."
sw.R: Basi nendeni mkawafanye watu wa kila taifa kuwa wanafunzi. Wabatizeni kwa jina la Baba, na la Mwana, na la Roho Mtakatifu. \v 20 Wafundisheni kufanya yote niliyowaagiza. Na kumbukeni, {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} niko pamoja nanyi kila siku, mpaka mwisho wa enzi hii."

vi.L: Vậy hãy đi làm cho muôn dân trở thành môn đồ, làm báp-têm cho họ vào danh của Cha, và của Con, và của Đức Thánh Linh, \v 20 dạy họ giữ mọi điều {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã truyền cho các con; và kìa, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} ở cùng các con mọi ngày cho đến lúc kết thúc của đời này."
vi.B: Vậy các con hãy đi, làm cho muôn dân trở thành môn đồ {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}: hãy làm báp-têm cho họ vào danh Cha, Con và Đức Thánh Linh, \v 20 và dạy họ giữ mọi điều {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã truyền cho các con. Và hãy nhớ rằng: chính {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} luôn ở cùng các con mỗi ngày, cho đến lúc kết thúc của đời này."
vi.R: Vậy các con hãy đi và làm cho người thuộc mọi dân tộc trở thành môn đồ {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}. Hãy làm báp-têm cho họ nhân danh Cha, Con và Đức Thánh Linh. \v 20 Hãy dạy họ làm theo mọi điều {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã truyền cho các con. Và hãy nhớ: {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} luôn ở cùng các con mỗi ngày, cho đến khi thời đại này kết thúc."

ko.L: 그러므로 가서 모든 민족을 제자로 삼아, 아버지와 아들과 성령의 이름 안으로 그들에게 세례를 주고, \v 20 내가 너희에게 명령한 모든 것을 지키도록 그들을 가르쳐라. 그리고 보라, 내가 시대의 끝까지 모든 날 동안 너희와 함께 있다."
ko.B: 그러므로 너희는 가서 모든 민족을 제자로 삼아라. 아버지와 아들과 성령의 이름으로 그들에게 세례를 주고, \v 20 내가 너희에게 명령한 모든 것을 지키도록 그들을 가르쳐라. 기억하여라. 내가 이 시대의 끝까지 날마다 너희와 함께 있다."
ko.R: 그러니 너희는 가서 모든 민족의 사람들을 내 제자로 삼아라. 아버지와 아들과 성령의 이름으로 그들에게 세례를 주어라. \v 20 그리고 내가 너희에게 명령한 모든 것을 지키며 살도록 그들을 가르쳐라. 기억하여라. 나는 세상의 끝 날까지 언제나 너희와 함께 있다."

pt.L: Indo, portanto, façam discípulos de todas as nações, batizando-os no nome do Pai e do Filho e do Espírito Santo, \v 20 ensinando-os a guardar todas as coisas que eu lhes ordenei; e eis que eu estou com vocês todos os dias até a consumação da era."
pt.B: Vão, portanto, e façam discípulos de todas as nações: batizem-nos no nome do Pai e do Filho e do Espírito Santo \v 20 e ensinem-nos a guardar tudo o que eu lhes ordenei. E lembrem-se disto: eu mesmo estou com vocês todos os dias, até o fim da era."
pt.R: Por isso, vão e façam discípulos entre as pessoas de todas as nações. Batizem essas pessoas em nome do Pai e do Filho e do Espírito Santo. \v 20 Ensinem a elas a fazer tudo o que eu mandei vocês fazerem. E lembrem-se: eu estou com vocês todos os dias, até o fim desta era."

am.L: እንግዲህ ሄዳችሁ አሕዛብን ሁሉ ደቀ መዛሙርት አድርጉ፤ [ይኸውም] በአብና በወልድ በመንፈስ ቅዱስም ስም እያጠመቃችኋቸው \v 20 ያዘዝኋችሁንም ሁሉ እንዲጠብቁ እያስተማራችኋቸው [ይሁን]። እነሆም፣ እኔ እስከ ዘመኑ ፍጻሜ ድረስ ቀኖቹን ሁሉ ከእናንተ ጋር ነኝ።»
am.B: እንግዲህ ሂዱና አሕዛብን ሁሉ ደቀ መዛሙርት አድርጉ፤ በአብና በወልድ በመንፈስ ቅዱስም ስም አጥምቋቸው፤ \v 20 ያዘዝኋችሁንም ሁሉ እንዲጠብቁ አስተምሯቸው። ይህንንም አስታውሱ፤ እኔ ራሴ እስከ ዘመኑ ፍጻሜ ድረስ በየቀኑ ከእናንተ ጋር ነኝ።»
am.R: ስለዚህ ሂዱና ከየሕዝቡ ሁሉ ሰዎችን ደቀ መዛሙርት አድርጉ። በአባት፣ በልጅና በመንፈስ ቅዱስ ስም አጥምቋቸው። \v 20 ያዘዝኋችሁን ሁሉ እንዲያደርጉ አስተምሯቸው። ደግሞም አስታውሱ፤ እስከዚህ ዘመን መጨረሻ ድረስ በየቀኑ ከእናንተ ጋር ነኝ።»

ru.L: Итак, пойдя, сделайте учениками все народы, крестя их в имя Отца и Сына и Святого Духа, \v 20 уча их соблюдать всё, что {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} заповедал вам; и вот, {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} с вами во все дни до завершения века.»
ru.B: Итак, идите и сделайте учениками все народы: крестите их в имя Отца и Сына и Святого Духа \v 20 и учите их соблюдать всё, что {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} заповедал вам. И помните: {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} сам с вами во все дни, до конца века.»
ru.R: Поэтому идите и делайте {{deity_pronoun:моими|Моими}} учениками людей из всех народов. Крестите их во имя Отца и Сына и Святого Духа. \v 20 Учите их исполнять всё, что {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} велел вам. И помните: {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} с вами каждый день, до конца этого века.»

hi.L: इसलिए जाते हुए सब जातियों को चेला बनाओ, उन्हें पिता और पुत्र और पवित्र आत्मा के नाम में बपतिस्मा देते हुए, \v 20 उन्हें सब बातें मानना सिखाते हुए जिनकी मैंने तुम्हें आज्ञा दी है; और देखो, मैं युग के अंत तक सब दिन तुम्हारे साथ हूँ।"
hi.B: इसलिए जाओ, और सब जातियों को चेला बनाओ: उन्हें पिता और पुत्र और पवित्र आत्मा के नाम में बपतिस्मा दो, \v 20 और उन्हें वह सब मानना सिखाओ जिसकी आज्ञा मैंने तुम्हें दी है। और यह याद रखो: मैं स्वयं युग के अंत तक हर दिन तुम्हारे साथ हूँ।"
hi.R: इसलिए जाओ और हर जाति के लोगों को चेला बनाओ। उन्हें पिता और पुत्र और पवित्र आत्मा के नाम से बपतिस्मा दो। \v 20 उन्हें वह सब करना सिखाओ जो मैंने तुम्हें करने को कहा है। और याद रखो, मैं इस युग के अंत तक हर दिन तुम्हारे साथ हूँ।"

uk.L: Тож, ідучи, зробіть учнями всі народи, хрестячи їх в імʼя Отця, і Сина, і Святого Духа, \v 20 навчаючи їх дотримуватися всього, що {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} заповів вам; і ось {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} з вами по всі дні аж до завершення віку.»
uk.B: Тож ідіть і зробіть учнями всі народи: хрестіть їх в імʼя Отця, і Сина, і Святого Духа \v 20 і навчайте їх дотримуватися всього, що {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} заповів вам. І памʼятайте: {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} сам з вами по всі дні, аж до кінця віку.»
uk.R: Тож ідіть і зробіть {{deity_pronoun:моїми|Моїми}} учнями людей з усіх народів. Хрестіть їх в імʼя Отця, і Сина, і Святого Духа. \v 20 Навчайте їх виконувати все, що {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} звелів вам. І памʼятайте: {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} з вами завжди, кожного дня, аж до кінця цього віку.»

ja.L: だから、行って、すべての国の民を弟子にしなさい。すなわち、父と子と聖霊の名へと彼らに洗礼を授け、\v 20 わたしがあなたがたに命じたすべてのことを守るように彼らに教えなさい。そして見なさい、わたしは世の終わりまで、すべての日々、あなたがたと共にいる。」
ja.B: だから、行って、すべての国の民を弟子にしなさい。父と子と聖霊の名によって彼らに洗礼を授け、\v 20 わたしがあなたがたに命じたことをすべて守るように教えなさい。よく覚えておきなさい。このわたしが、世の終わりまで、いつの日もあなたがたと共にいる。」
ja.R: だから、行って、あらゆる国の人々をわたしの弟子にしなさい。父と子と聖霊の名によって、その人たちに洗礼を授けなさい。\v 20 わたしがあなたたちに命じたことを、すべて守るように教えなさい。そして、忘れてはいけない。わたしは、世の終わりまで、毎日いつも、あなたたちと一緒にいる。」

decisions.choice: all the nations: all peoples, Israel among them
decisions.reason: The word can mean "the nations" in general or "the Gentiles" as distinct from Israel. Before, Jesus sent the Twelve only to Israel (10:5-6; 15:24). Now the limit is lifted: the good news is for every people, as in 24:14 and 25:32, where "all the nations" stand before the Son of Man. Some read the word here as the Gentiles alone.

decisions.choice: into the name: into belonging to the one God, Father, Son and Holy Spirit
decisions.reason: "Name" is singular for all three. To be baptized into someone's name is to be brought under that one's ownership and care. This is the only place in Matthew where the Father, the Son and the Spirit are named together; at Jesus's baptism all three were present (3:16-17).

decisions.choice: I am with you: the promise of Immanuel, God with us
alternatives: a promise of the disciples' memory of him
decisions.reason: Matthew began with the name Immanuel, "God with us" (1:23); he ends with Jesus's promise, "I am with you." God gave the same promise to Moses, Joshua and Israel (Exodus 3:12; Joshua 1:5; Haggai 1:13). The completion of the age is the end of this world's time, when the Son of Man comes (13:39-40, 49; 24:3).

decisions.choice: the end of the Gospel, without "Amen"
alternatives: the completion of the age. Amen.
decisions.reason: Many later manuscripts end the Gospel with "Amen". Several of the earliest lack it, and the SBLGNT leaves it out. Reviewers should check the evidence against the apparatus.

decisions.choice: Going (L); Go ... baptize ... teach (B, R)
decisions.reason: The first participle shares the force of the command, so Balanced and Readable say "go". "Baptizing" and "teaching" say how disciples are made; Balanced keeps them under the command with a colon, and Readable gives them as short commands.

decisions.choice: And remember this: I myself am with you (B); And remember, I am with you (R)
alternatives: and look, I am with you
decisions.reason: The word for "look" calls the hearers to attend to the promise. The pronoun "I" is written out for emphasis, which Balanced brings out with "myself".

decisions.choice: keep
decisions.reason: The verb means to keep or guard, as one keeps commandments (19:17). "Keep" holds both doing and holding on to what Jesus commanded.

decisions.choice: people from every nation; in the name
alternatives: all the nations; into the name
decisions.reason: Readable says that the disciples are made from among the people of the nations, as "them" shows, and uses the familiar "in the name"; the meaning note explains "into".

decisions.choice: en el nombre (every level)
decisions.reason: The Greek says "into the name", baptism into belonging to the one God (meaning decision m2). Spanish "en" covers both "in" and "into", while "para" or "hacia" would not read as Spanish, so every level says "en el nombre"; the meaning decision carries the sense.

decisions.choice: la consumación de la era (L); el fin de la era (B); el fin de esta era (R)
decisions.reason: As in 13:49: the Greek speaks of the close of the present age, which "era" keeps; Readable follows the English "this age" here.

decisions.choice: dans le nom (L, B); au nom (R)
decisions.reason: The Greek says "into the name", baptism into belonging to the Father, the Son and the Holy Spirit (m2). "Dans le nom" keeps the movement, as the English "into" does; Readable uses the familiar "au nom", as the English Readable says "in the name".

decisions.choice: la fin de l’âge (L); la fin de l’âge présent (B); la fin du monde (R)
decisions.reason: The same words as for the same phrase in 13:39-49 in French. "Moi" at Literal and "moi-même" at Balanced carry the emphatic "I" and take the deity_pronoun span, since Jesus speaks of himself.

decisions.choice: katika jina (L, B); kwa jina (R)
decisions.reason: The Greek says "into the name", baptism into belonging to the one God (meaning decision m2). "Katika jina" keeps that at Literal and Balanced; Readable uses the familiar "kwa jina", as the English Readable says "in the name".

decisions.choice: utimilifu wa enzi (L); mwisho wa enzi (B); mwisho wa enzi hii (R)
decisions.reason: As in 13:49: the Greek speaks of the close of the present age, which "enzi" keeps; Readable follows the English "this age" here.

decisions.choice: "muôn dân" (L, B); "người thuộc mọi dân tộc" (R)
decisions.reason: All peoples, Israel among them (footnoted meaning decision); "muôn dân" says that, where "dân ngoại" would leave Israel out.

decisions.choice: "vào danh" (L, B); "nhân danh" (R)
decisions.reason: The meaning decision reads "into the name" as coming to belong to the one God; Literal and Balanced keep "vào", and Readable uses the familiar "nhân danh", as the English Readable says "in the name".

decisions.choice: "lúc kết thúc của đời này" (L, B); "khi thời đại này kết thúc" (R)
decisions.reason: The wording of the Vietnamese Matthew 13:40 and 24:3 for the same Greek phrase.

decisions.choice: "모든 민족"; "이름 안으로" (L), "이름으로" (B, R) for eis to onoma
decisions.reason: All peoples, Israel among them (meaning decision, footnoted), so not the word for Gentiles. Baptism into the name means coming to belong to the one God (meaning decision); Literal keeps the Greek "into", Balanced and Readable use the usual Korean phrase.

decisions.choice: "시대의 끝" (L); "이 시대의 끝" (B); "세상의 끝 날" (R) for synteleia tou aionos
decisions.reason: The forms of the Korean Matthew 13:39-40 and 24:3, so the close of the Gospel echoes Jesus' teaching on the end of the age.

decisions.choice: no nome (L, B); em nome (R)
decisions.reason: Portuguese has no natural "into the name"; "para o nome" is not idiomatic. Literal and Balanced say "no nome", the name as the place one is brought into (m2); Readable uses the familiar formula "em nome de", as the English Readable says "in the name".

decisions.choice: a consumação da era (L); o fim da era (B); o fim desta era (R)
decisions.reason: The Greek speaks of an age brought to its completion (m3). "Era" says that without the archaic "séculos" or the narrower "fim do mundo".

decisions.choice: "በአብና በወልድ በመንፈስ ቅዱስም ስም" (L, B); "በአባት፣ በልጅና በመንፈስ ቅዱስ ስም" (R); "በ... ስም" ("in the name") at every level
decisions.reason: "አብ" and "ወልድ" are the living church words for the Father and the Son in the baptismal formula, so Literal and Balanced keep them; Readable uses the plain words. Amharic cannot say "baptize into a name", so every level says "in the name"; the meaning decision explains the Greek "into".

decisions.choice: "[ይኸውም] ... [ይሁን]" around the two participles
decisions.reason: An Amharic sentence cannot end on a participle, so Literal keeps the Greek's "baptizing ... teaching" as participles and brackets the words that let the sentence close ("that is, ... let it be").

decisions.choice: "सब जातियाँ" (L, B), "हर जाति के लोग" (R); "बपतिस्मा देना"; "चेला बनाना"
decisions.reason: The style guide gives "जातियाँ" for "the nations"; "अन्यजाति" would exclude Israel, which meaning decision m1 includes. "बपतिस्मा" is the living church word, and "चेला बनाओ" keeps the link with the disciples ("चेले") of 28:16.

decisions.choice: "все народы" (L, B); "люди из всех народов" (R)
decisions.reason: "The nations" here are all peoples, Israel among them, as the meaning decision says, so the style guide's "народы" is used rather than "язычники".

decisions.choice: "в имя" (L, B); "во имя" (R)
decisions.reason: Literal and Balanced keep "into the name", baptism into belonging to the one God; Readable uses the familiar "во имя", and the meaning note explains the sense.

decisions.choice: {{deity_pronoun:моими|Моими}} учениками (R)
decisions.reason: Readable says whose disciples they become, and Jesus' pronoun takes the usual span, where the English has none.

decisions.choice: "усі народи" (L, B); "люди з усіх народів" (R)
decisions.reason: The meaning decision reads "all the nations" as all peoples, Israel among them; "язичники" would leave Israel out.

decisions.choice: "до завершення віку" (L); "до кінця віку" (B); "до кінця цього віку" (R)
decisions.reason: The Greek speaks of the close of the present age, not of the physical world; "вік" keeps that.

decisions.choice: "父と子と聖霊の名へと" (L); "父と子と聖霊の名によって" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the preposition "into", which speaks of being brought under the one name of Father, Son and Holy Spirit (meaning decision m2). Balanced and Readable use "名によって", the natural and fixed Japanese for this formula, as the English Readable uses "in the name". "名" stays singular for all three.

decisions.choice: "行って" with the command; "すなわち……授け……教えなさい" (L); two commands (B, R)
alternatives: "洗礼を授けながら、教えながら" (L)
decisions.reason: The participles say how disciples are made. Japanese cannot end a sentence on them, so Literal joins them to the command with "すなわち" and keeps each verse's words after its own marker; Balanced and Readable give them as commands, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "あなたがたと共にいる" (L, B), "あなたたちと一緒にいる" (R); "世の終わり" (every level); "見なさい" (L), "よく覚えておきなさい" (B), "忘れてはいけない" (R)
decisions.reason: "共に" and "一緒に" are the words of the Immanuel name in 1:23 in Japanese, so the Gospel's last promise answers its first (meaning decision m3). The completion of the age is "世の終わり" as in 13:39-40, 13:49 and 24:3.
